posts.zh:
dsh-hindsight-local-optimize 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a110c12876520210c172.html
posts.en:
dsh-hindsight-local-optimize is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a110c12876520210c172.html
